Emily / Matthew —

Really appreciate the clarity. Quick reply while I loop in finance and RevOps: we can be flexible, but Net-90 is outside of our standard payment terms for pilot / initial-year deals.

Two paths I can propose immediately so we don't lose runway:

1) Quarterly invoicing + Net-60 (standard concession for larger pilots).
2) Quarterly invoicing + Net-90 but with a one-time pre-funded deposit equal to 1 quarter of forecasted usage (applied to first invoice).

If AlphaHealth prefers option 2 we can push it through but will need expedited approval from finance. Option 1 I can likely get approved quickly with RevOps and sales leadership sign-off.

Folks — forwarding AlphaHealth's ask. Quick analysis and recommended path: 

Summary of request:
- Quarterly invoicing + Net-90 on invoices.

Risk & notes:
- Net-90 materially increases DSO and credit exposure. Historical pilot cohorts on Net-90 have a 12% incidence of late payment >120 days.
- Quarterly invoicing reduces our ability to reconcile monthly usage variances; SOW needs clearer milestone-based invoicing or a minimum commitment.

Recommended options to offer (ranked):
1) APPROVE: Quarterly invoicing + Net-60 (no deposit) — mitigated risk with monthly usage reporting and a 60-day review clause.
2) ALTERNATE: Quarterly invoicing + Net-90 WITH first-quarter prepayment (applied to invoice) OR letter of credit.
3) DENY: If AlphaHealth insists on Net-90 without prepayment, escalate to credit committee for extended review and require additional safeguards (SLA credits, stricter termination terms).

If we go with option 1, RevOps (me) can update payment terms and SOW quickly; if option 2 or 3 we need executive sign-off and a formal credit review.

Please reply with approvals/changes. If no objections by EOD Monday, I'll draft the updated SOW for signature.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

Team — after reviewing the ask and AlphaHealth's profile, I'm approving a one-time concession to keep momentum. Conditions below: 

Approved concession (one-time, applied to pilot year):
- Quarterly invoicing as requested.
- Payment terms: Net-60 from invoice date (Net-90 denied without prepayment).
- Commercial concession: 7.5% service credit (discount) applied to billed amount for the first 12 months.

Conditions & operational items:
- Require a minimum first-quarter prepayment equal to 30% of the expected quarterly invoice as a commitment (reduces credit exposure).
- Add a clause in the SOW requiring monthly usage reporting to our CS & Finance teams and a 60-day conduct review.
- Legal to include an express termination for non-payment >90 days.

Lauren — please confirm finance is comfortable with the above. Marissa/Neha — update SOW and DocuSign routing. Karthik — communicate the approved terms to Emily and get signature.

Approved by:
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
